create_LocomotionController: create a LocomotionController instance with a robot, gait generator, state estimator, and leg controllers
reset_LocomotionController: reset the LocomotionController and all its subcomponents to their initial state at time zero
update_LocomotionController: update the LocomotionController time and propagate the update to the gait generator, state estimator, and leg controllers
get_action_LocomotionController: get the combined motor control actions for all swing and stance legs from the LocomotionController
review_LocomotionController_properties: review the LocomotionController properties to access the swing leg controller, stance leg controller, gait generator, and state estimator
